categories.main_business_segments: China Longyuan Power Group Corporation Limited primarily operates in the development and operation of new energy power generation, focusing on wind power, photovoltaic (solar) power, tidal, and geothermal energy projects. The company also engages in electricity trading, power generation rights trading, technical services, and energy storage equipment rental and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced wind power technologies including offshore, low wind speed, high altitude, and deep-sea wind power exploration. It has developed the world's first floating wind-fishing integration technology and employs digital transformation initiatives such as the 'Longteng No. 1' intelligent management platform and comprehensive meteorological big data pools. The company also emphasizes innovation in cluster wind and solar power bases, hydrogen-based energy, and digital intelligent control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Longyuan Power serves primarily the electricity market in China, including provincial and regional power grids, and participates in green electricity and carbon trading markets. It also serves overseas markets with projects in Canada, South Africa, Ukraine, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. Its customers include electricity market members such as sales companies and electricity users, as well as government and industrial entities involved in renewable energy consumption.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in China, excluding Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. It also has international projects in Canada, South Africa, Ukraine, Cambodia, Brunei, Indonesia, and other countries along the Belt and Road Initiative and BRICS nations.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Longyuan Power operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the renewable energy supply chain, focusing on power generation, electricity sales, and related technical and operational services. It also engages in upstream activities such as resource evaluation and project development but mainly functions as a power producer and service provider within the energy supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes accelerating scale development, digital transformation, innovation-driven leadership, and safety compliance. It emphasizes R&D in new energy storage technologies, carbon footprint reduction, offshore wind power, and integrated renewable energy systems. The '1+1+4+N' technological innovation system and digital platforms support its R&D efforts, alongside collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through electricity sales from wind power, photovoltaic power, and other renewable energy sources. Additional revenue streams include electricity trading, power generation rights trading, technical consulting services, energy storage equipment rental, repair services, and sales of commodity materials. The company also benefits from government grants and participates in green certificate and carbon trading markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Longyuan Power is positioned as a leading wind power operator in China and globally, maintaining the largest consolidated installed capacity in wind power within the industry. It competes with other major power generation groups in China and international renewable energy companies, leveraging its scale, technological innovation, and integration with CHN Energy to sustain its market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the Group’s consolidated installed capacity reached 41.14 GW, with wind power accounting for 30.41 GW. The company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 31.37 billion and a net profit of RMB 8.37 billion, reflecting steady growth and improved operational efficiency. Capital expenditures increased to RMB 29.2 billion in 2024, supporting ongoing expansion and technological upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Longyuan Power emphasizes inherent safety, doubled scale, digital transformation, and innovation-driven leadership as its core value propositions. It differentiates itself through pioneering floating wind-fishing integration technology, comprehensive digital management platforms, and a broad geographic footprint. The company’s commitment to green development, ESG practices, and integration of new energy with ecological and rural revitalization initiatives further enhance its competitive edge.
